summary_1line: Ghatotkacha is named and departs; the exiled Pandavas wander in disguise until Vyasa guides them to live safely in Ekachakra.

image_candidates.scene_text: The bald-headed infant Ghatotkacha bows to touch the feet of his mother Hidimva and father Bhima immediately after his birth.
The Pandavas in bark garments and matted locks carry their mother Kunti through a forest during their wandering exile.
Sage Vyasa meets the disguised Pandavas in the forest and gestures toward the distant town of Ekachakra where they will hide.
